text:
### Right to Erasure
**Customer Request:** "Delete my data"
**Your Action:**
- Acknowledge request
- Send to DPO
- DPO reviews legal requirements (may need to retain for regulatory reasons)
- Delete if legally possible
name: Chunk 23/61

raw_entities.name: Right to Erasure Request Acknowledgement
raw_entities.description: Staff must acknowledge a customer's right to erasure request when received. This is the first step in the data deletion process and establishes a documented record of the customer's intent.

raw_entities.name: Right to Erasure Escalation to Data Protection Officer
raw_entities.description: Staff must escalate all right to erasure requests to the Data Protection Officer (DPO) for legal review. This ensures compliance with data protection regulations and identifies any legal retention obligations that may override the erasure request.
context: DPO reviews legal requirements (may need to retain for regulatory reasons)

raw_entities.name: Right to Erasure Legal Review and Conditional Deletion
raw_entities.description: The DPO must review legal and regulatory retention requirements before approving data deletion. Data may only be deleted if no legal obligation requires retention. This balances customer privacy rights with regulatory compliance duties.
context: DPO reviews legal requirements (may need to retain for regulatory reasons)

raw_entities.name: Data Protection Officer
raw_entities.description: The Data Protection Officer is the designated authority responsible for reviewing right to erasure requests, assessing legal retention obligations, and determining whether customer data can be lawfully deleted.
